body: Travis Scott @travisscott has reportedly touched down in Chicago just hours before Ye takes over Soldier Field tonight 👀🔥 Flight trackers appeared to show Travis’ jet heading into the city ahead of the sold-out show, immediately sparking speculation that he could join Ye onstage. Nothing has been confirmed yet, but the timing definitely has fans watching 👀 📸:
